title: Contact page
brief: We are Northfield Studio, a small design studio in Manchester, and we need a contact page for people thinking of hiring us. On the left, a short friendly intro headed "Let's talk about your project" with our studio address, phone number and opening hours listed underneath. On the right, a simple form: full name and email side by side, a topic dropdown, a roomy message box, a consent checkbox and a send button. It should feel calm, clean and trustworthy, all sitting on one white card on a pale grey-blue page. Use a deep teal as the one accent, for the small 'Contact' label above the heading and the send button.

requirements.text: The page has one main heading, "Let's talk about your project", with a short intro paragraph under it
The intro side lists the studio address, phone and hours, each under its own small label, in that order
The intro sits on the left and the form on the right, side by side on one white card
The form has, in order: full name and email in one row, a topic dropdown, a message box, a consent checkbox and a 'Send message' button
The topic dropdown offers New project enquiry, Existing project, Careers and Press, with the first one shown
Every field has a visible label, the email field is an email input, and name, email, message and consent are required
The fields show example placeholder text rather than being blank
One teal accent colour is used for the small label and the button only
Text is easy to read against its background

designNotes: one white card on a pale page
teal accent used only for the label and the button
small uppercase labels above the contact details
